name: SqlClient6SqlServer2025
description: SQL Server as pengdows.crud testbed runs it (SqlServerTestContainer, TestbedImageMatrix latest).

types.query: SELECT name, CASE WHEN name IN ('varchar','nvarchar','char','nchar','binary','varbinary') THEN name + '(100)' WHEN name IN ('decimal','numeric') THEN name + '(28,10)' WHEN name IN ('datetime2','time','datetimeoffset') THEN name + '(7)' WHEN name = 'vector' THEN 'vector(3)' ELSE name END FROM sys.types WHERE is_user_defined = 0

exclude.timestamp: rowversion is generated by the database
exclude.sql_variant: its CLR type is whatever the stored value is
